Parameters of a fitted model

Source: R/model-inspect.R
mt_parameters.Rd

Returns the estimated parameters of a fit in one long table, for every model type that has interpretable parameters:

Usage

mt_parameters(fit)

Arguments

fit

An mt_fit object.

Value

A data.table with stratum, parameter, index (age label, year or position), value and, for Bayesian fits, lower and upper.

Details

  • lee_carter(): a (age pattern), b (age pattern of change), k (period index), and the drift and innovation standard deviation of k;

  • li_lee(), product_ratio(): the common factor of each group (B, K, its drift and standard deviation), and per stratum the deviations a, b, k and their AR(1) coefficient phi and standard deviation;

  • rwd(): drift and innovation standard deviation per age (and, with observation_noise = TRUE, the variances of level and noise);

  • apc_bayes(): posterior medians and 90% intervals of the age, period and cohort effects (logit scale, bamp's identification), and the Gelman-Rubin statistics (rhat, values below 1.1 indicate convergence) of the identified quantities.

Fits of wrapped packages (StMoMo, demography) keep the original fitted object in fit$fits[[i]], where the methods of those packages apply.

See also

summary.mt_fit(), residuals.mt_fit().

Examples

x <- mt_example(deaths = "single")
p <- mt_parameters(mt_fit(lee_carter(), x))
head(p)
#>    stratum parameter  index     value
#>     <char>    <char> <char>     <num>
#> 1:  female         a     30 -7.530513
#> 2:  female         a     31 -7.438225
#> 3:  female         a     32 -7.453512
#> 4:  female         a     33 -7.353122
#> 5:  female         a     34 -7.325712
#> 6:  female         a     35 -7.275708
